evidence.note: MTLD3D12Device::CheckFeatureSupport is the current runtime implementation.
Phase 4 will prove these reports without launching a game.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS.risk: Over-reporting can push games into unimplemented render paths.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS1.risk: WaveOps reporting must remain coupled to the 32-lane dispatch/readback corpus.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS3_WRITE_BUFFE.risk: Copy-queue timestamps are coalesced to the Metal command buffer GPU end time and resolved through a completion handler; write-immediate flags are coupled to exact default, marker-in, and marker-out GPU virtual-address readback coverage on direct, compute, and inlined bundle command lists.

D3D12_METAL_RAYTRACING_HARDWARE.risk: Metal hardware support is only a prerequisite; DXR tier must remain unreported until acceleration structures, state objects, shader tables, synchronization, and DispatchRays pass behavior gates.

required_fields: two-geometry indexed/non-indexed triangle and procedural AABB BLAS BuildRaytracingAccelerationStructure
ARRAY and ARRAY_OF_POINTERS BLAS descriptor layouts
BLAS COPY_MODE_CLONE and cloned-BLAS TLAS traversal
in-place BLAS PERFORM_UPDATE refit from translated to centered geometry
in-place AABB PERFORM_UPDATE refit from translated to centered geometry
in-place TLAS PERFORM_UPDATE refit from translated to centered instance
COMPACTED_SIZE postbuild query and traversed COPY_MODE_COMPACT output
raygen/miss state-object exports with stable distinct shader identifiers
raygen, miss, triangle any-hit/closest-hit, procedural intersection/closest-hit, and callable shader-table records
DispatchRays raygen, miss, any-hit, closest-hit, procedural intersection, and callable execution
recursive closest-hit to miss TraceRay at depth 2
AddToStateObject hit-group alias growth with inherited stable identifiers and execution
D3D12_DXR_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURES.risk: A two-geometry indexed/non-indexed triangle BLAS, one-AABB BLAS, behavior-proven BLAS clone, shifted triangle/AABB/TLAS refits, compacted-size query, traversed compact copy, a three-instance TLAS, mask-isolated inline RayQuery hit, stable distinct export identifiers, executed base/grown hit-group records, raygen/miss/triangle-any-hit/closest-hit/procedural-intersection/callable records, and depth-2 recursive TraceRay prove foundational DXR execution; mixed triangle/AABB BLAS geometry, larger geometry/instance arrays, serialization/deserialization, new-library state-object growth, and complete local-root/shader-table semantics remain gated.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS7.risk: The AS/MS eight-byte payload, stage-specific root-CBV/raw-SRV, 32-lane mesh texture/sampler/UAV, and two-group direct/indirect DispatchMesh readback gate does not yet prove mixed render-state matrices, statistics, render-target arrays, or broad shader/payload coverage required to report mesh tier 1.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS11.risk: Should stay conservative unless descriptor-heap atomic64 is implemented.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS8.risk: The support report is backed by creation and upload/readback of a 7x5 BC1 texture with exact two-row block payload validation.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS9.risk: Should stay conservative unless atomic64 is actually implemented.

D3D12_FEATURE_LEVEL_12_2_TARGET.risk: Raising the central maximum before every FL12_2 behavior gate passes would recreate false-success device creation.

D3D12_FEATURE_FEATURE_LEVELS.risk: UE5 may reject the adapter if this disagrees with shader model or options queries.

D3D12_FEATURE_SHADER_MODEL.risk: SM 6.7 is behavior-backed by the SM 6.6 root-constant, descriptor-indexing, 64-bit, atomic/barrier, and texture/sampler runtime corpus plus SM 6.7 QuadAny/QuadAll dispatch/readback; additional SM 6.7 advanced texture operations remain separate optional behavior gates.

D3D12_SYNTHETIC_SHADER_CORPUS.risk: Game captures must remain diagnostic; shader support claims require synthetic corpus coverage.

purpose: Keep D3D12 feature reports aligned with executable implementation reality.
